observability_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - Observability Specification & Incident Playbook

incident_response_playbooks.name: Data Provider Outage (Missing Session EOD Feed)
incident_response_playbooks.action: HALT_DECISION_GENERATION. Engine holds current positions unchanged. No synthetic or imputed data may be fabricated. Log MISSING_SESSION_ALERT to journal.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Corrupt Observation Delivery (NaN, Negative, or Spurious Spike)
incident_response_playbooks.action: Quarantine bad bar with reason NONFINITE_OR_NONPOSITIVE_PRICE. Hold previous closing price or omit symbol from rebalance calculations for that single session.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Double-Entry Balance Sheet Mismatch (> $0.01 Residual)
incident_response_playbooks.action: IMMEDIATE_FAIL_CLOSED_HALT. Abort all order execution. Dump diagnostic memory state to audit file. Require manual human reconciliation before resumption.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Protected Source Hash Mismatch (agent.py or D2 mutated)
incident_response_playbooks.action: IMMEDIATE_FATAL_SECURITY_STOP. Refuse to execute. Alert that frozen baseline immutability has been compromised.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Unauthorized Forward or Live Activation Attempt
incident_response_playbooks.action: FAIL_CLOSED_REJECTION. ActivationGatekeeper raises FatalSecurityViolation and logs attempt with timestamp and client caller stack trace.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Duplicate Order Dispatch Attempt
incident_response_playbooks.action: Reject duplicate order via idempotent order ID registry. Log DUPLICATE_ORDER_REJECTED.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Recovery Snapshot Hash Mismatch
incident_response_playbooks.action: FAIL_CLOSED_ABORT. Refuse to load corrupt snapshot. Require rollback to previous known-good cryptographic checkpoint and journal replay.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Data Provider Terms of Service Change
incident_response_playbooks.action: Pause ingestion feed. Conduct legal review against private research checklist before resuming.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Unscheduled Git Working Directory Mutation
incident_response_playbooks.action: Block forward runner. Require clean git index prior to session evaluation.

incident_response_playbooks.name: Risk Limit Breach (Drawdown > 20% or Concentration > 30%)
incident_response_playbooks.action: TRIGGER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER. Pause automated evaluation. Generate incident report for mandatory owner review.
